title: Emo-Jev：基于Jev概率推理的情感分类框架
summary: Emo-Jev是一个无需训练的框架，利用Jev的概率决策接口进行文本分类。它包含两种实现：Emo-Jev-D将分类分解为原子判断并组合概率，Emo-Jev-SC构建多路径判断并聚合共识。在八个数据集上评估，标准Jev平均macro-F1为62.93%，低于最强LLM基线的67.28%，但延迟和成本更低。
summary_en: Emo-Jev is a training-free framework leveraging Jev's probabilistic decision interface for text classification. It offers two implementations: Emo-Jev-D decomposes classification into atomic judgments and composes probabilities, while Emo-Jev-SC builds multiple judgment paths and aggregates consensus. Evaluated on eight datasets, standard Jev achieves 62.93% average macro-F1 versus 67.28% for the strongest LLM baseline, with lower latency and cost.
